contrastPairs.$description: Opaque sRGB WCAG contrast ratios, rounded to six decimals. Eligibility is published once per pair as aaNormalText rather than restated in prose: >= 4.5 is AA normal text, >= 3 is AA large text and non-text, and recommendedTextUse names the role the pair clears it for. Each pair resolves its exact hex colors through foregroundToken and backgroundToken in this document, and carries recommendedTextUse only when the pair clears AA for the role it was measured for; an absent recommendation means the pair is unsuitable or reserved for a non-text role. These measurements do not certify gradients, opacity, imagery, font sizing or an entire component.

deepSpace.$description: Base dark palette. Dim and boundary are not recommended as essential text even when a numeric threshold passes.
